off_recording.how: fixtures/off-golden.json was written by tests/responses_run_budget.rs off_control::records_the_off_golden, run against the unchanged production code of base_sha in a git-archive copy of that commit (only tests/responses_run_budget.rs added to the copy; its src/ is the archive's), with no wallet selected; the compatible paths go to a fake on 127.0.0.1, the direct path to a proxy on 127.0.0.1 that closes each CONNECT
off_recording.command: RESPONSES_RUN_BUDGET_OFF_OUT=<out> HEAVY_LOCK_CLASS=cargo with-heavy-lock cargo test -j 4 --test responses_run_budget -- --exact off_control::records_the_off_golden, run twice in the base copy; the two outputs were byte-identical (cmp), and two runs of the current code were byte-identical too
normalization: the run's temporary root -> <ROOT>; the fake's loopback address -> <LOOPBACK>: each run makes its own

a JSON number under duration_ms, occurred_at_epoch_ms, executor_ms, provider_ms, total_ms, time_profile_provider_ms, time_profile_total_ms -> 0: found by diffing two unnormalized runs, which differed in these keys only (wall-clock time)
build_commit, build_dirty, build_timestamp -> <BUILD>: the identity of the binary, which is another build for the base and for this code
in .commandagent/lock, pid and run_id -> <PID>, <RUN>: differed between the two unnormalized runs
estimated_stable_prefix_chars is not normalized: each run is its own process
